dedupe_keys.name: experimental data for emerging contaminants and pathogenic microorganisms elimination in secondary effluent by graphitic carbon nitride photocatalytic ozonation processes

description: The source explicitly identifies experimental data for eliminating emerging contaminants and pathogenic microorganisms from secondary effluent using graphitic carbon nitride and photocatalytic ozonation. A related journal article has the same full study title and named author team. The deposit lists one experimental-data workbook. This establishes a wastewater-treatment experimental resource, without revealing individual contaminant names, ozone doses, pathogen counts, treatment efficiencies or measurement uncertainty in the inspected metadata. The article is supporting evidence and is not a second dataset. The source authors provide these water-quality study data; geographic coverage is not stated. The deposit lists publicly accessible files under CC BY 4.0. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Data values, archives, images and linked article or poster bodies remain unread. The reported treatment subject establishes the resource role, while measurement quality, independent sample counts and overlap with related experiments remain unverified.
